text:
maya: Quick sync — need to pick a default tenant connectivity approach for private deploy packaging. Options on the table: 1) SNAT relay (our relay + NAT; minimal field ops), 2) Customer-managed egress (customer provides egress IPs and firewall config), 3) Dedicated peering (BGP/peering). Need decision on default, upgrade paths, and fallback behavior. TL;DR: what do we ship first and how do we let customers move between modes?

owen: +1 for SNAT relay as the default for Q1 — lowest friction for field. Main concerns: cost at scale and IP exhaustion. We should implement per-tenant rate limits and per-pool IP quotas.

samir: Relay makes sense for rapid onboarding. For compliance/regulatory customers we must support customer-egress opt-in. Also: how do we handle NAT64/IPv6-only environments? Need a design note.

katie: Proposal: default = relay, opt-in = customer-egress, peering = Dedicated tier only. Fallback: if configured customer-egress fails health checks, agent automatically falls back to relay. Also require operator toggle per-tenant without full redeploy.

netops-jules: Peering requires contracts, ASNs, and long lead time — not suitable as default. If we offer peering, gate it behind Dedicated/reserved capacity and a checklist (BGP config, ACLs, peering test plan).

maya: Action items: 1) acceptance criteria + migration steps, 2) packaging checklist (firewall rules, IP ownership, DNS entries, latency tests), 3) upgrade semantics (how to flip per-tenant). @samir can you draft the migration API? @owen capture relay sizing/ops constraints.

samir: Will do. Rough API sketch:
```
POST /tenants/:id/connectivity
{ "mode": "relay|egress|peering", "egress_ips": ["1.2.3.4"], "asn": "64512" }
```
I'll flesh out validation and error codes in a gist tomorrow.

maya: Also define rollback: automatic revert to relay if health checks fail consecutively (suggest 3 retries), and surface rollout status in Console. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/private-connectivity-checklist (draft) :robot_face:

katie: I'll schedule a 30m sync with Field Ops and Customer Success tomorrow to validate the checklist and ask templates. Will share agenda beforehand.

owen: Note for packaging notes: include IP rotation cadence and guidance for customers who want static egress IPs.

maya: Ok — consensus: relay default + customer-managed egress opt-in for MVP; peering staged for Dedicated enterprise flow. I'll update the roadmap ticket with acceptance criteria and link the draft doc.

(ended quick thread)
